name: IntegrateIT PlayStation 5
notes: Display-only Control4 AV source for a Sony PlayStation 5 (or any HDMI PlayStation). Exposes an HDMI OUT binding so the console can be wired to a TV, AVR, or matrix input and selected in Watch — one tap switches the room's video input and audio path to the PlayStation. Controls nothing and reports nothing by design: there is no reliable one-cable power protocol for a console, so the driver does not pretend to have one. Wake the console from the controller (or HDMI-CEC); a future version may add network wake-on-demand.
